results.title: Crash Land
results.overview: Lance, Clay, and Darby have spent their childhoods drinking, wreaking havoc, and filming crude stunts in their small town. Everyone hates them. Wanting to finally prove their lives have meaning, the boys set out to make a “real movie” and in the process are forced to confront emotions and experiences they’ve never considered: love, loss, and ultimately, what it means to grow up.

results.title: My Grandfather Charles Manson
results.overview: Sophia was always the good girl growing up and her father's rock, but her quest to identify her unknown grandfather results in a shocking discovery: He is Charles Manson, history's most notorious criminal; and he bears striking physical similarities to her beloved father. Sophia's discovery propels her into an underworld of Manson family members and unreliable narrators as she traces her grandfather's life. Along the way, her genetics unlock never-before-released records and audio recordings that illuminate Manson's pathology in startling ways. But the more Sophia uncovers, the more her relationship with her father is strained. For Sophia, there's no turning back. What has she inherited, and how will she reckon with her family legacy?

results.title: (MOURNING) AFFIRMATIONS
results.overview: (MOURNING) AFFIRMATIONS is a dreamy short film that drifts through mental struggle, grief, and fractured memory, structured around the relentless voiceover of a self-help tape. Set in the gloomy landscape of Berlin, the film exposes the quiet violence of compulsory wellness, the demand to cope, to heal, to be “okay,” and explores what emerges when we stop performing stability and allow ourselves to unravel.

results.title: NJPW Presents CMLL Fantastica Mania 2026 - Day 6
results.original_title: NJPW Presents CMLL Fantastica Mania 2026 - Day 6
results.overview: The sixth night of Fantastica Mania 2026 was a professional wrestling event co-produced by Japanese promotion New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) and Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial De Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on February 26, 2026 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: Poultrygeist II: Dawn of the Chicken Dead
results.original_title: Poultrygeist II: Dawn of the Chicken Dead
results.overview: A global poultry pandemic sets the stage for a wealthy tech tycoon to attempt to relaunch a failed fast-food empire using lab-grown synthetic chicken. Things go horribly wrong when these artificial food supplies unleash a wave of mutant chicken zombies.

results.title: Anton Belyaev’s LAB: The Big Test
results.overview: A documentary film about what goes on behind the scenes of a large-scale music show by Anton Belyaev and the band Therr Maitz.

results.title: BINGE
results.overview: A girl with an insatiable appetite goes on a late night adventure into a different state of mind.

results.title: The Night Mother Returns Home
results.original_title: ឱបសពម្តាយ​ 3 ថ្ងៃ
results.overview: Srey Neang is a service worker struggling to care for her 7-year-old daughter, Srey Roth, often returning home late at night. One evening, she collapses and dies inside their home, unnoticed by her daughter. Believing her mother is only sick, Srey Roth sleeps beside her for three days. Srey Neang’s spirit remains behind, protecting her child and haunting those whose cruelty tore them apart, refusing to leave her daughter alone.

results.title: Alterity
results.overview: A group of paranormal researchers discover a dormant alien invasion force hidden in an abandoned shopping mall slated for demolition.

results.title: A Match Made in Melbourne
results.overview: Georgie, a travel writer, travels to Melbourne for an assignment where she meets Zach, an ex-Australian footballer who agrees to be her tour guide and shows her that there's more to life than work.

results.title: Chatni
results.overview: A young engineer abandons his secure job to continue his family's 115-year farsan tradition, working to transform their classic chutney recipe into a contemporary brand while overcoming obstacles and family skepticism.

results.title: Khan Tumhara
results.overview: A genre blend of action sequences with romance and drama, centering on the character Yusuf Khan, described as navigating power, love and vengeance.

results.title: Good Behaviour
results.overview: A surreal psychological drama about a tormented prisoner who undergoes an talking therapy to reframe the memories of his crime. Starring Antonio Aakeel (Slow Horses, Sherlock & Daughter), Paul McGann (Withnail & I, Doctor Who) and Stephen Walters (This City Is Ours, Outlander).

results.title: Steckerlfischfiasko
results.overview: Franz Eberhofer and Rudi Birkenberger's next case takes them to Niederkaltenkirchen's new golf course. The two detectives promptly get caught up in a full-blown family feud between two folk festival clans.

results.title: Esther
results.overview: The whole world was enthusiastic about Esther, but the Germans were hypnotized. Esther and Abi Ofarim appeared to them not only as representatives of a musical internationalism… but above all as messengers of Israel and a new generation that might find ways of reconciliation.

results.title: The Lake
results.overview: An environmental nuclear crisis threatens Utah. Two scientists and a politician urgently work to prevent an unprecedented catastrophe in their home state.
